provenance: Native omadesign WGPU viewport recordings. Seeded example documents; actual egui pointer and keyboard input during replay. The only overlay is a pointer indicator. No audio.

chapters.label: Layout
chapters.description: Rotate the selected shape and round its corners with the Layout controls.

chapters.label: Appearance
chapters.description: Add a stroke, inspect stroke options, and change the fill to a gradient.

chapters.label: Typography
chapters.description: Adjust the headline spacing and explore OpenType features.

chapters.label: Reshape
chapters.description: Enter Warp mesh and drag a real cage handle to reshape the artwork.

chapters.label: Effects
chapters.description: Add a drop shadow in the native Effects panel.

chapters.label: Trace
chapters.description: Inspect tracing options and the Ignore white setting.

chapters.label: Layers
chapters.description: Compare Multiply and Normal blend modes on the artwork layer.

chapters.label: Brush
chapters.description: Adjust the brush size and paint a highlight on a separate layer.

chapters.label: Retouch
chapters.description: Choose the Healing brush, Alt-click a source, and blend a short stroke into the painting.

chapters.label: Mask
chapters.description: Add a layer mask and brush away part of the new highlight.

chapters.label: Color
chapters.description: Inspect the color picker and choose a project palette color for the brush.

chapters.label: Layers
chapters.description: Compare layer blending and use Undo on the actual document.

chapters.label: Light
chapters.description: Adjust exposure and shadows, then compare the original with Before.

chapters.label: Color
chapters.description: Warm the scene slightly and adjust vibrance in the Color panel.

chapters.label: Detail
chapters.description: Add a gentle clarity and vignette adjustment.

chapters.label: Library
chapters.description: Switch between library images, return to the coast, and compare Before.

chapters.label: Presets
chapters.description: Apply Draw stroke to the selected rings and play the actual animation.

chapters.label: Keyframes
chapters.description: Open Keyframe controls and work with keys in the native timeline.

chapters.label: Appearance
chapters.description: Inspect stroke appearance on the animated artwork.

chapters.label: Reshape in Design
chapters.description: Switch the same document to Design, adjust a Perspective handle, then return to Motion.

chapters.label: Layers
chapters.description: Compare blend modes and play the edited animation.

chapters.label: Palettes
chapters.description: Choose colors from two project palettes and apply them to the selected shape.

chapters.label: Brand assets
chapters.description: Filter the project asset bank, drag an SVG onto the artboard, and undo its placement.

chapters.label: Typography
chapters.description: Apply project Heading and Body font roles to the selected headline.
